data.name: The Liminal Rite
data.detailed_description:
Tired of rural life, you fled to the city.

But one day, a letter from your mother calls you back to your hometown.

The moment you step off at the nearest station—

everything goes black. When you wake up, you find yourself in Yomotsuka Village of the past.

The village is eerily empty.

The only person you encounter is a lone young girl.

The villagers... have turned into mysterious, monstrous creatures.

—Escape this cursed village together with the girl.

What secrets lie hidden in the village's past?

Why did the villagers become monsters?

And... can you ever return to your own time?

Horror × Time Travel × Survival Action

A nostalgic yet unsettling recreation of rural Japan in the Showa era

The only human left is... your grandmother from her younger days

Villagers have transformed into grotesque creatures—run or fight

Use weapons and items to uncover the village's dark secrets

Your choices will shape the story's ending

■ Controls

Keyboard + Mouse

Xbox Controller

DualShock 4

■ Save System

You can save your progress at save points scattered throughout the village.

Note: After using a save point, it will be unavailable for 5 minutes.

The game also autosaves at key events.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Intel/AMD
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia/AMD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Disable or Lower Shadow/Texture/Screen Resolution/SSR Quality for better performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10/11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K or AMD
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
